Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

The role

We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager to bring Perchwell's product to market (GTM). You will influence the positioning and messaging for our product, specializing in the product and customer launches that put each release in front of Executive leadership, staff, and real estate agents, and the communication programs that move thousands of real estate agents onto the Perchwell platform. You will execute product and customer launches, run the launch calendar, and build the systems that let a small team ship at the pace the product does.

Perchwell releases to every customer at once and ships continuously, so product launches are a steady stream rather than a few big moments a year. Each release needs messaging that is accurate for the people who run Multiple Listings Services (MLS) and useful to the agents who use our product, along with the assets that drive adoption. The launch process has to be systematic for this to work, and you will grow into owning it end to end, from the roadmap conversation with Product through go-live and the post-launch read on adoption.

Customer launches are the second half of the job. When an MLS moves its membership onto Perchwell, the transition runs over several months. You would build each communication plan with the MLS and our Customer Success team, write what goes out, and carry what you learn into the next one.

We strive to build a systematic marketing team enabled by AI, and the right candidate for this role should be eager to learn and implement AI as a core component of the role. The marketing team implements a shared library of skills, knowledge, and workflows, and we expect this person to extend it. Every recurring step in a launch is a candidate for a system that produces a reviewable first draft in minutes, and you would build and maintain those systems so the team's output keeps up with the product's release pace.

This role will report into the Product Marketing Lead. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong writing, product judgment, and the organizational discipline to keep several launches moving at once, and who is eager to build the function as we grow quickly.

What You Will Do

Product launches and communication

Run the launch cadence for each release: the brief, the asset checklist, the timeline, and go-live, with Product and Customer Success inputs tracked and chased.
Write the positioning and messaging for each product area, from Search and Add/Edit to Client Collaboration, Reports and Analytics, Admin, and Mobile, and keep the messaging source of truth current.
Produce the launch assets: release messaging, help center articles and updates, Intercom macros for the support team, MLS staff enablement briefs, member emails, What's New entries, and in-app messages.
Turn a technical capability into what an agent, an MLS admin, or an MLS CEO can now do, in their words.
Keep product pages, one-pagers, and demo-deck sections current as the product moves.

Customer launches

Own the member-facing communication plan for each MLS conversion, from announcement through the parallel period, training cohorts, cutover, and the first months after.
Develop campaigns that drive adoption: announcement and reminder emails, newsletter sections, training invitations, town hall materials, FAQ and support Q&A docs, and creative campaigns.
Work directly with the MLS's leadership and staff, and with Perchwell's Customer Success and implementation team, to execute launches as a team.
Track adoption through launches and feed what you learn into the next launch.
Partner with Customer Success to capture testimonials and case studies to enable the Sales team and marketing materials.

Systems and velocity

Build and maintain AI skills and templates, so recurring work starts from a system rather than a blank page.
Run the launch calendar, cross-functional inputs, and post-launch reviews as a repeatable process, and tighten it after every launch.
Use AI in your own research and production: competitive scans, customer transcript review, first drafts, and checks against the house voice.

What Success Looks Like

Product launches ship on schedule with a complete asset set, and MLS staff have what they need to answer member questions on day one.
Customer launches hit their cutover dates with members informed, trained, and using the platform.
Perchwell's product and service story is tailored to each audience and consistently reinforced in all collateral.
Launch assets take less time each quarter because the systems behind them improve.

Who You Are

You have 3+ professional experience in product marketing, lifecycle or customer marketing, content marketing, or an adjacent role at a B2B software company where you owned launches, campaigns, or a content program end to end.
You write clearly and can show it.
You bring structure to cross-functional work. You build the plan, keep the checklist, chase the inputs, and hit the date, usually on several projects at once.
You are comfortable in front of customers.
You want to understand how real estate agents, brokers, and MLSs work, and you can learn a technical product fast.
You work easily with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Design, and keep people informed without being asked.
You use AI tools every day and have turned at least one recurring piece of work into a system other people rely on.
You take a project from idea through execution and iteration without being managed closely.
You seek feedback and apply it.
Have a willingness to travel.

Real estate or proptech experience is a plus.

Salary band: 130-150k

The salary range does not reflect total compensation, which includes base salary, benefits, and company equity. Compensation for this role depends on several factors including location, work experience, job-related skills, business needs, and market demands.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.
Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.

Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.

Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.

Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.

Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.

Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.

Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.

Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.

Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.

Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.

You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.
We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

added.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The Impact You Will Have

Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.
Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.
Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.
Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.
Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.
Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.
An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.
Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.
Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.
A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.
The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About The Team

You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.
The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.
It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.
The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms

Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.
Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.
Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.
AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements

Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.
Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements

Schedule: None; fully remote.
Frequency: None.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.
Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.
Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.
The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000.
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

added.description:
Description

Regional Media Buyer — Paid Media

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We are looking for a Regional Media Buyer to build, launch, and optimise paid media campaigns for your assigned region. This is a hands-on execution role at the core of how Xe acquires customers. Day to day, you will be inside the platforms — building campaigns, managing budgets, and tracking performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads.

Xe runs paid media as a centralised, best-practice-led function. That means you will not be inventing your own way of doing things in isolation: you will execute against shared briefs, campaign structures, and naming conventions, apply the standards the global paid media team sets, and keep your region's setup consistent with the rest of the business. Your value is in flawless, fast, and accurate execution — campaigns that go live correctly, budgets that pace to plan, and data that everyone can trust.

We believe in using AI to optimise how we work. We want someone who is AI-forward — using it to build smarter systems and integrations, speed up competitor research, and take the manual weight out of execution and reporting — while keeping their own judgment firmly in the driver's seat. AI is a tool that makes a sharp buyer sharper; it is not a substitute for understanding the platforms, the data, and the strategy behind the work.

You will report to the Global Manager of Paid Media and work closely with the other regional buyers, as well as with design, analytics, and the wider marketing team. This is a strong role for someone early in their paid media career who wants to go deep on execution across every major channel and grow within a global team.

OUR PRINCIPLES

AMBITION - We dream big, try things out and always ask "why not?" and "what if?" We're ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.

RESPONSIBILITY - We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.

COMMUNITY - We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

Roles & Responsibilities

Building & Executing Campaigns

Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube), Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads for your assigned region.
Set up campaigns to the shared standard — consistent structures, naming conventions, tracking, and audience/keyword configuration — so your region's account is clean, organized, and easy to read.
Write and traffic ad copy, keywords, audiences, and creative assets into each platform, and coordinate with design to get the assets you need on time.
Turn briefs from the global paid media team into live, correctly configured campaigns, and get them to market quickly and accurately.

Optimization & Best Practices

Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, beta features, and best-practice updates across Google, Meta, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads, and put them into practice in your accounts.
Run day-to-day optimization — bids, budgets, audiences, keywords, negatives, placements, and creative rotation — to improve performance against targets.
Support and execute structured tests (creative, audience, bidding, landing page) and document what you learn so it can be applied across regions.
Flag opportunities and risks early and bring ideas for what to try next.

Working AI-Forward

Use AI tools to work faster and smarter — drafting and iterating ad copy, generating and analyzing competitor research, summarizing performance data, and taking the repetitive work out of setup and reporting.
Look for ways to build AI into your systems, integrations, and workflows so your region runs more efficiently, and share what works with the wider paid media team.
Apply your own judgment to everything AI produces — validating outputs, sense-checking against the data, and owning the final decision. We want AI accelerating your work, not doing your job for you.

Budget Management

Manage and pace campaign budgets to plan — monitor daily and weekly spend, avoid over- and under-delivery, and reallocate within your region as performance dictates.
Keep accurate records of spend by channel and campaign, and reconcile against the plan.
Escalate pacing issues, budget shortfalls, or unexpected cost changes promptly.

Data Tracking & Reporting

Own accurate tracking for your campaigns — UTMs, conversion tracking, and correct tagging — so results are measured cleanly and consistently.
Pull performance data from each platform and Xe's reporting tools, and maintain clear, up-to-date reporting on the metrics that matter (spend, CAC, conversions, and channel efficiency).
Use the shared measurement framework and metric definitions so your region's numbers line up with the rest of the business.
Surface insights from the data — what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change — in regular reporting to the Global Manager of Paid Media.

Position Requirements

1–3 years of hands-on experience building and managing paid media campaigns, ideally in-house or at an agency.
Direct, in-platform experience with at least two of Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads, and the appetite to become strong across all four.
Comfortable building campaigns from scratch — structures, keywords/audiences, ad copy, and tracking — and keeping accounts organized and consistent.
Solid understanding of paid media fundamentals: bidding, budgeting, audience targeting, and the core metrics (CPC, CPA/CAC, ROAS, conversion rate).
Experience managing and pacing campaign budgets, with a careful, detail-oriented approach to spend.
Comfortable working with data: pulling performance reports, setting up conversion tracking and UTMs, and reading results accurately.
Highly organised and reliable, able to manage multiple live campaigns at once and follow shared processes and standards closely.
Eager to keep up with a fast-changing landscape and put new platform features and best practices into use.
AI-forward: you actively use AI tools to speed up execution, research, and reporting, and to build better systems and integrations — while relying on your own judgment to check the output and make the calls.

Real problems. Real ownership.

Our engineers, designers, underwriters, and actuaries build together. The problems span turning messy documents into reliable data, making pricing more precise, and designing AI agents that can take on increasingly complex underwriting work.

630+ customers / $500B+ insured project value

Our investors

Capital to build. Partners to grow with.

Our backing brings together investors who build technology companies and partners who understand insurance. We are building a company that earns the confidence of both.

Director of Marketing

About The Role

As Director of Marketing, you will own how Shepherd reaches and engages commercial insurance brokers, both online and in person. Brokers are our distribution channel, and marketing in commercial insurance has historically been limited. We think there's an opportunity to do things differently.

You'll build our brand, develop content that brokers actually want to engage with, and run events that bring the right people together. You'll work closely with underwriting, business development, and leadership to make sure our marketing programs are reaching the right brokers and ultimately driving more submissions.

Own our content strategy across LinkedIn, email, newsletters, and other channels where we can reach brokers.
Work with underwriters and other subject matter experts to create content that's useful, interesting, and relevant to our audience.
Build campaigns that keep Shepherd top of mind with brokers, whether they've never worked with us or submit regularly.
Experiment with different formats and channels, measure what works, and double down on the ones that drive engagement.

Develop creative campaigns that help us stand out from traditional carriers and MGAs.
